properties.evidence: Answers the obvious hazard before anyone spends time on it. "Does removing the dependency break storyflow, which also uses dynograph?" — no: that fact measured storyflow consuming dynograph as a REST API over HTTP while reflow2 consumes it as a Rust library API. Disjoint surfaces over one shared implementation, so dropping the Rust surface cannot touch storyflow's endpoints. Drawn from the fact TO this idea: the measurement is what removes the risk.
